_note: AEM-authored per-course content captured from the live source DOM (NOT in the /v1/lms/courses/all API). Keyed by course name. badge = /content/dam path on source. Merge with the API dataset (courses-api.json) by name/code for tags/modules/language.

Introduce Your Child to Tennis.desc: This module empowers parents to introduce tennis to their children. Also available in Spanish.

Introduzca a su Hijo al Tenis (Introduce.desc: Este módulo permite a los padres introducir a sus hijos en el tenis.

Supporting Your Child in Competition.desc: Enhancing the parent and child relationship in competition.

Tennis in Physical Education.desc: Whether you're brand new to tennis or looking to enhance your current curriculum, this course equips you with the tools, activities, and confidence to deliver inclusive, skill-based tennis lessons right in your PE class—no court required.

Intro to Coaching 1.desc: These modules introduce the essentials of coaching, helping individuals explore their potential as a coach, embrace positive coaching principles, and implement play-based rally techniques to create engaging and developmentally-appropriate sessions. Also available in Spanish.

Introducción al Entrenamiento 1 (Intro t.desc: Estos módulos presentan los fundamentos del entrenamiento, ayudan a las personas a explorar su potencial como entrenadores, adoptar principios de entrenamiento positivos e implementar técnicas de juego basadas en el intercambio de pelotas para crear sesiones atractivas y adecuadas para el desarrollo.

Intro to Coaching Workshop.desc: This workshop is designed to help coaches organize players of all ages, provide basic coaching in a group setting, and establish an athlete-centered environment.

Coaching High School Tennis.desc: This badge signifies expertise in guiding high school athletes with an athlete-centered approach, focusing on pre-season preparation, parent and team management, effective practice execution, match play strategies, and post-season planning.

Empowering Girls.desc: This badge highlights expertise in fostering girls' participation in sports by challenging gender stereotypes, recognizing their unique identities, addressing their needs, and employing strategies to engage, support, and empower them through coaching.

Inclusive Coaching.desc: Equipping coaches with emotional intelligence, empathy, and effective strategies for engaging and supporting Gen Z athletes through social and emotional learning and conflict resolution.

Athlete-Centered Coaching.desc: This badge reflects mastery of USTA's coaching philosophy, including playful learning, the 5C's, communication skills, and effective equipment use for athlete development.

Intro to Coaching 2.desc: Access to this badge requires Safe Play approval. It equips coaches with foundational skills, including play-based games, effective feedback techniques through 'Stop-Show-Go,' and practical application of the 5C's to foster holistic player development. Also available in Spanish.

Introducción al Entrenamiento 2 (Intro t.desc: Para acceder a esta insignia es necesario contar con la aprobación de Safe Play. Proporciona a los entrenadores habilidades fundamentales, como juegos basados en el juego, técnicas eficaces de retroalimentación a través de «Stop-Show-Go» y la aplicación práctica de las 5 C para fomentar el desarrollo integral de los jugadores.

Applied Coaching Skills - Private.desc: Beginner and intermediate individual lessons focused on building foundational skills and introducing basic strategies.
Applied Coaching Skills - Private.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the Developing Junior and Adult Players Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Applied Coaching Skills - Group.desc: Beginner and intermediate group lessons focused on building foundational skills and introducing basic strategies.
Applied Coaching Skills - Group.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the Developing Junior and Adult Players Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Athletic Development by Multi SkillZ®.desc: Equipping players with the skills, mindset, and physical foundation needed for success.
Athletic Development by Multi SkillZ®.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Developing Junior and Adult Players.desc: Cultivate young athletes' skills through progressive, age-appropriate training. Enhancing adult players' skills through progressive, tailored training that emphasizes technical fundamentals.
Developing Junior and Adult Players.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Coaching Wheelchair Tennis.desc: This badge involves coaching athletes with disabilities, focusing on sport chair setup, mobility patterns, technical skills, and strategic approaches for singles and doubles play.
Coaching Wheelchair Tennis.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the Athlete Centered Coaching Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Coaching Intellectual and Developmental.desc: This badge equips tennis coaches with a comprehensive framework for supporting athletes with Coaching Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities Tennis (IDD), covering everything from foundational inclusion and behavioral strategies to on-court skill delivery and long-term program design.
Coaching Intellectual and Developmental.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to have a Rally or above package.

Events and Social Play.desc: This badge showcases skills in fostering participation and community engagement by understanding the importance and types of play, creating inclusive experiences, and utilizing various formats for individual and team activities.
Events and Social Play.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

CPR/AED and First Aid Awareness.desc: CPR/AED and First Aid equips coaches with essential CPR, First Aid, and AED awareness to ensure safe and responsive environments for all players.

Cardio Tennis.desc: This badge represents foundational knowledge and skills for delivering engaging Cardio Tennis sessions, mastering progressive triples formats, and effectively organizing activations to inspire participation and community involvement.
Cardio Tennis.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to have a Rally or above package.

Cardio Tennis Workshop.desc: This workshop is designed to give on court foundational knowledge and skills for delivering engaging Cardio Tennis sessions, mastering progressive triples formats, and effectively organizing activations to inspire participation and community involvement.to help coaches organize players of all ages, provide basic coaching in a group setting, and establish an athlete-centered environment.
Cardio Tennis Workshop.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to have a Rally or above package.

Coaching Female Athletes: Menstrual Heal.desc: Created by Coaching Her, this badge provides coaches insight into how the menstrual cycle impacts athletes' physical and emotional well-being, providing coaches with the knowledge and confidence to support girls, reduce stigma, foster trust, and enhance overall performance and participation.
Coaching Female Athletes: Menstrual Heal.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Player Motivation and Engagement.desc: This badge represents mastery in fostering motivation through understanding self-determination theory, creating a supportive environment, effective communication, promoting a growth mindset, and using leadership to inspire and engage players.
Player Motivation and Engagement.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Delivering Competition.desc: This badge represents proficiency in navigating the USTA Competition Pathway, leveraging Serve Tennis tools, understanding ratings and rankings, and effectively organizing tournaments, team events, and advanced competitive opportunities like Pro Circuit and collegiate events.
Delivering Competition.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Intro to Tennis Coaching Business.desc: This badge highlights proficiency in managing the key aspects of coaching as a business, including team leadership, programming, facility operations, financial management, and effective sales and marketing strategies.
Intro to Tennis Coaching Business.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Coach Well-Being.desc: Created by the USOPC, this badge helps coaches build practical, personal strategies to prevent burnout and sustain well-being in the demanding world of coaching.
Coach Well-Being.unlock: To unlock this course you will have to complete the USTA Coaching Development Coach Badge and have a Rally or above package.

Intro to Park and Recreation.desc: This badge supports USTA's mission to inspire healthier people and communities everywhere. It is designed to introduce parents, volunteers, coaches, and instructors to the Park and Recreation industry, equipping them with the necessary knowledge, tools, and confidence to successfully contribute to tennis programming.

Rules and Regulations 1.desc: This introductory badge covers the 31 rules of tennis established by the International Tennis Federation (ITF), including who governs the rules and the process for how they are officially changed.

Rules and Regulations 2.desc: This badge covers the yearly changes to the rules and regulations of tennis, its point penalty system, and an overview of medical timeouts.

Rules and Regulations 3.desc: This badge reviews "The Code," the athlete's guide to fair play, and includes a summary of the unwritten rules of tennis.
